content: Toi Ibraime hibar bou edde hibar hár kissu loiyore Mišorottu niyoli zai Negevot giye, ar Lut o hibar fũwati aššil.
Ibraim goru, soole edde šuna rufaye kub beši tuwangor aššil.
Bade hibaye doine Negevottu ek zagattu ar ek zagat zaite zaite Betel foijjonto aišše, Betel edde Aior maza mazi ze zagat age hibar ṭambu aššil,
edde zeṛe hibaye foila kurbangah tiyar goijjil. Heṛe Ibraime Mabudor nam ḍaikke.
Ar Ibraimor fũwati giyede, Lutottu o, goru sool edde ṭambu okkol aššil.
Kintu zagaganot hitara dunizon ekotro bošoti gora šombob no o, kiyollahoile hitarar šombotti eto oṭṭalika aššil ze hitara ekku fũwati taki no fare.
Ar Ibraimor zanuwar soroya edde Lutor zanuwar soroya okkolor maze hoijja uiṭṭe. Ar he šomot Kenaniyo edde Perišiyo okkol o he dešot bošoti gorito.
Toi Ibraime Lutore hodde, "Sa, tui edde ãr maze, tor zanuwar soroya edde ãr zanuwar soroya okkolor maze hono hoijja no ok, kiyollahoile ãra to egena.
Tor sarme fura deš udda fori no take ne? Meherbani gori tui ãttu alok oizagoi! Tui zodi ban ḍaikka zos ãi den ḍaikka zaiyum, ar zodi tui den ḍaikka zos ãi ban ḍaikka zaiyum."
Lute suk tuli sadde Zordanor fura niso zaga, Soar foijjonto hár zaga zola edde saite Mabudor baganor ḍoilla otóba Mišoror ḍoilla. (Iyan aššilde Mabude Súdum edde Gumorrare dongšo goribare age.)
Hetolla Lute Zordanor hár elehare nizolla basi loiyore fuk mikka giyegoi. Ei bafe hitara ekzon loi arekzon alok oiye.
Ibraim Kenan dešot ar Lute he elehar niso zagar šohorgunot edde Súdum foijjonto ṭambu maijje.
Súdum šohoror manuš okkol aššilde beši horaf edde Mabudor berudde beša beši guna gorat aššil.
Lut Ibraim loi alok oizaigoi bade Mabude Ibraimore hodde, "Tui ze zagat asos hentu suk tuli uttor doin fuk fosim beggulla sa,
haron tui ze zaga okkol dehor hin ãi tore edde tor bongšore azibonolla diyum.
Ar duniyair dúilor ḍoilla tor bongšo baraiyum; honokiye zodi duniyair dúilore goni fare, toile tor bongšore o gona zaibo.
Uṭ, ei dešganor lamba edde fatari gurisa, kiyollahoile ãi tore iyan diyum."
Toi Ibraime ṭambu hãri loiyore Hebronot asede Mamre elun gas bonor ḍake zaiyore bošoti goijje, edde heṛe Mabudor mutallek ekkan kurbangah tiyar goijje.
